one_liner: AI notetaker that records, transcribes, and summarizes team meetings.

evidence.claim: Personal Access Tokens for the API are self-serve, generated in Grain app settings
The public API also supports OAuth2 Authorization Code flow with PKCE for third-party integrations
evidence.quote: The API supports a standard OAuth2 Authorization Code flow, including the PKCE extension for client-side only authentication.

evidence.claim: Documented REST endpoints cover recordings, transcripts, upload/download, tags, sharing, hooks, users, teams, and meeting types
Grain has a free-forever plan, so credential generation is not tied to payment
Grain's official site references a GraphQL API and TypeScript SDK for developers
evidence.quote: Learn how to use the GraphQL API and TypeScript SDK

notes: v1 API is being sunset ('we don't recommend usage of v1 anymore'); build on v2. Workspace Access Tokens grant ALL DATA in the workspace and are generated only 'by users with access', implying an admin/role gate for workspace scope. Nango (third-party) claims OAuth developer access is 'limited to select partners', so OAuth app registration may be gated even though PATs are self-serve. Homepage touts Claude/ChatGPT export and 'Claude accessing Grain connectors', but no official MCP server is documented in the supplied material.
